info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Reward By Reward Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed information about specific banking operational services rewards using a unique reward identifier. It provides insights into the rewards offered, including eligibility criteria, redemption options, and associated benefits. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions, third-party financial service providers, and mobile banking applications looking to enhance user engagement through rewards programs. The endpoint is instrumental for applications that aim to provide customers with personalized offers based on their banking activities.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about reward RES-100045
